prior_answer: It cannot be answered on the merits from the question alone: the marked nonzero center and the identity of the blue target curve are not specified. scans.t_val_basis: At 601.0 s the real frame first makes P_pi(x) and the term c1(x-pi)^1 readable while the pi-centered point and blue cosine curve remain on screen; 600.0 s contains no formula.
scans.answer_at_t_val: The marked center is pi and the blue target is cos(x). Evaluating cosine and its first two derivatives at pi gives c0=cos(pi)=-1, c1=-sin(pi)=0, and c2=(-cos(pi))/2=1/2, hence P_pi(x)=-1+(x-pi)^2/2.
